content:
; obligations.txt — Proof obligations for spec.md in SMT-LIB2 format.
;
; Checker: Z3 (version 5.1.0), run in SMT-LIB2 mode:
;   /tmp/pylibs/bin/z3 -in < obligations.txt
;   or:  /tmp/pylibs/bin/z3 obligations.txt
;
; Theory: unbounded integers (LIA). The function symbols add and multiply are
; declared below and axiomatized as the mathematical operations the spec's
; Definitions section assigns to the Python functions (integer sum and
; product); the probe checks in verify_spec.py tie these symbols to the
; arith.py implementation.
;
; Proof method: refutation. Each obligation is stated as the NEGATION of the
; property it claims. An expected `unsat` answer proves the property for all
; integers; a `sat` answer would expose a concrete counterexample.
;
; Expected output: exactly five `unsat` lines, one per check-sat, in order.

(set-logic LIA)

; ---- Declarations ----

(declare-fun add (Int Int) Int)
(declare-fun multiply (Int Int) Int)

; Axioms: add/multiply behave as integer sum/product for all arguments.
(assert (forall ((a Int) (b Int)) (= (add a b) (+ a b))))
(assert (forall ((a Int) (b Int)) (= (multiply a b) (* a b))))

; ---- Obligation 1: Commutativity of add (spec.md, Property 1) ----
; Claim:  forall a b. add(a, b) = add(b, a)
; Obligation: negation of the claim is unsatisfiable.
(push)
(assert (not (forall ((a Int) (b Int)) (= (add a b) (add b a)))))
(check-sat) ; expect: unsat
(pop)

; ---- Obligation 2: Associativity of add (spec.md, Property 2) ----
; Claim:  forall a b c. add(add(a, b), c) = add(a, add(b, c))
(push)
(assert (not (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
  (= (add (add a b) c) (add a (add b c))))))
(check-sat) ; expect: unsat
(pop)

; ---- Obligation 3: Commutativity of multiply (spec.md, Property 3) ----
; Claim:  forall a b. multiply(a, b) = multiply(b, a)
(push)
(assert (not (forall ((a Int) (b Int)) (= (multiply a b) (multiply b a)))))
(check-sat) ; expect: unsat
(pop)

; ---- Obligation 4: Associativity of multiply (spec.md, Property 4) ----
; Claim:  forall a b c. multiply(multiply(a, b), c) = multiply(a, multiply(b, c))
(push)
(assert (not (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
  (= (multiply (multiply a b) c) (multiply a (multiply b c))))))
(check-sat) ; expect: unsat
(pop)

; ---- Obligation 5: Distributivity of multiply over add (spec.md, Property 5) ----
; Claim:  forall a b c. multiply(a, add(b, c)) = add(multiply(a, b), multiply(a, c))
(push)
(assert (not (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
  (= (multiply a (add b c)) (add (multiply a b) (multiply a c))))))
(check-sat) ; expect: unsat
(pop)
